notes.measured_time_component: Recorded rather than applied: it names the share of a family's ported multiplier that the model's predicted seconds already carry, so the residual premium beside it is what the ledger still charges and composition must not apply both.
notes.amortized_model_surcharge: Keyed by model name; an entry's value is that model's expected per-job load-and-eviction seconds, the probability a job triggers a load times the measured load duration plus the re-read cost of the models it displaces, recomputed from the training snapshot at each round and priced at the sampler-second weight.
notes.served_variety_kudos_per_assigned_swap: Counted by the server from its own assignment history, as a change of model between consecutive jobs it handed the same worker, so nothing in a submit payload can inflate it.

sampler_second.provenance: The numeraire by definition: the serialized sampler slot is the resource every other one is weighted against.

pp_lane_second.provenance: Declared policy: post-processing runs beside the sampler on a disaggregated worker, so a lane-second costs less than a sampler-second without being free, and the figure is provisional until fleet saturation telemetry can estimate it.
